scenarios.name: landfall-experience-then-attack-earthbends
scenarios.why: Landfall gives an experience counter when a land I control enters; whenever I attack, earthbend X where X is my experience counters. With one landfall and one attack, earthbend 1 animates the targeted Forest into a 1/1 haste land creature with one +1/+1 counter.

scenarios.name: attack-with-no-experience-earthbends-zero
scenarios.why: With no experience counters, X is 0: the targeted Forest becomes a 0/0 creature with no +1/+1 counters, so the state-based action puts it into the graveyard; its earthbend promise then returns it to the battlefield tapped as a plain land.
